note: Transcribed from the code-reviewer's hand-back by the coordinator (finding text abridged; the SubagentStop salvage hook wrote no file). All 8 findings were addressed or dispositioned in this run.

review.finding: False positive for Extension-scope and adopted projects: fr_trace_coverage is now ERROR over every live FR row, so inherited/adopted FR rows (never interviewed) hard-block update-step. No test covers an Extension or adopted project.
review.suggestion: Limit the ERROR to rows of this run, or keep inherited/adopted FRs at WARNING; add a test.

review.finding: False positive on legacy 5-column FR tables: the 3rd cell is taken as Name, which is Priority in the older '| ID | Name | Priority |' layout; such a project becomes 'interview expected' and fails fr_trace_coverage on every row.
review.suggestion: Find the Name column from the header row; add a 5-column test.

review.finding: A bare document path containing a space is not refused, so load_brief turns the path into the app description (the silent swap this change should stop).
review.suggestion: Treat a single-line source with a doc suffix and a path separator as file-like; add a test with a spaced directory.

review.finding: The new blocking check human_signoff is not documented in hooks-and-pipeline.md, grill-trace-format.md, step-8-completion.md or the module docstring.
review.suggestion: Document human_signoff in all four places.

review.finding: Tests miss the main contract: no test calls main() or checks exit code 3; oversized file, bare missing path and spaced path are untested.
review.suggestion: Add a main() test with monkeypatched argv; parametrise refusals.

review.finding: Brief-pointer detection is a substring search for 'project brief mode'; a real transcript mentioning the phrase is treated as a pointer.
review.suggestion: Match the exact line brief_project_mode.apply writes.

review.finding: _has_brief_dir re-implements read_run_config; unguarded read_text calls can raise OSError and collapse the whole grill result into one opaque failure.
review.suggestion: Reuse read_run_config; guard reads with try/except OSError.

review.finding: Stray whitespace-only hunks (extra blank line after imports, trailing blank line at EOF).
